description: Confirmation of Director Generals appointed on acting basis to the respective Posts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval had been granted by the Cabinet decision dated 2020-01-02 to appoint Mr. M.K.C Senanayake, then a Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Planning Service to act full time in the Post of Director General of the Department of Fiscal Policy of the General Treasury and by the Cabinet decision dated 2024-12-09 to appoint Mr. P.M.K Hettiarachchi, then a Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Planning Service to act full time in the Post of Director General of the Department of Development Finance. In terms of the provisions of the Minute of the Sri Lanka Planning Service, the two Officers were promoted to the Special Grade of the Sri Lanka Planning Service by the Public Service Commission, on seniority basis, with effect from 2026-01-01. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to appoint Mr. M.K.C. Senanayake to the post of Director General of the Department of Fiscal Policy and Mr. P.M.K. Hettiarachchi to the post of Director General of the Department of Development Finance on permanent basis, with effect from 2026-01-01, was approved by the Cabinet.
